critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3145 lines — should be split into modular routers (chat.py, auth.py, admin.py, etc.) for maintainability
Chat attachment upload endpoint binds attachment to conversation only after first message — orphan attachments (uploaded but never sent) persist in storage/DB indefinitely; consider a TTL cleanup job
/api/files/chat/{path} serves the raw blob in a Response — for large files this loads entire file in memory; consider streaming for files near 5MB
Reset token expiry uses ISO string + manual fromisoformat parse; safer to store native datetime in Mongo to avoid tz parsing edge cases
Polling-based chat (every 3s) — works for MVP but consider WebSocket/SSE upgrade for scale

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows; Pro sidebar nav-messages and ProfessionalProfile message-pro-btn verified via source-code inspection (pro@test.com lacks completed profile so dashboard sidebar is gated; this is pre-existing app behavior, not a chat-feature defect)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test users. New conversation created between client@test.com and pro@test.com with multiple text messages and one PNG attachment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat + forgot/reset password fully working. All 28 backend pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_chat_and_password_reset.py pass. Admin moderation UI confirmed end-to-end via Playwright. The pro@test.com test account has no completed professional profile so its post-login screen is the 'Complete Your Profile' gate — to E2E test the pro Messages sidebar link, either (a) create a professional profile for pro@test.com first, or (b) use an existing pro that has a profile. ProfessionalProfile route is /professional/:id (not /professionals/:id); list/search is at /search. Re-runnable suite: pytest backend/tests/test_chat_and_password_reset.py -v
